guide.title: Use the same runtime without Hooks
guide.titleZh: 不用 Hooks，也能接同一套运行时
intro: React 16.3 has context, refs, and fragments, but no Hooks. The default Pling React entry therefore requires React 16.8+.
This example keeps the application on React 16.3.0 and imports the legacy entry. The page still gets actions, records, scoped data, read-only state, the agent loop, and the shared assistant dock.
introZh: React 16.3 有 context、ref 和 Fragment，但没有 Hooks，所以 Pling 的默认 React 入口要求 React 16.8+。
这个示例把应用留在 React 16.3.0，并改用 legacy 入口。页面依然拥有动作、记录、区域、只读状态、Agent 循环和共享助手 Dock。

steps.title: Import the pre-Hooks entry
steps.body: The legacy entry exposes class/render-prop components. It does not import the Hooks implementation or a second agent loop.
steps.bodyZh: legacy 入口提供 class/render-prop 组件，不导入 Hooks 实现，也没有第二套 Agent 循环。

steps.title: Mount with ReactDOM.render
steps.body: React 16.3 does not have createRoot. The Provider and page mount through the React 16 API, while the Pling runtime is created once outside render.
steps.bodyZh: React 16.3 没有 createRoot。Provider 和页面通过 React 16 API 挂载，Pling 运行时在 render 之外只创建一次。

steps.title: Declare a scope and records
steps.body: PlingScope and PlingRecord use render props. Their only child receives the ref that binds the real DOM element; business state stays in the class.
steps.bodyZh: PlingScope 和 PlingRecord 使用 render props。唯一子节点接收 ref，把它绑定到真实 DOM；业务状态仍留在 class 中。

steps.title: Declare controls where they already live
steps.titleZh: 在原有控件旁声明动作
steps.body: Each PlingTool wraps the real input or button. People and the agent execute the same React handler; there is no parallel automation path.
steps.bodyZh: 每个 PlingTool 包住真实输入框或按钮。人和 Agent 执行同一个 React 处理函数，没有平行的自动化路径。

steps.title: Expose a compact state view
steps.body: PlingState exposes totals and the active filter, not the entire component state. Writes still go through declared actions and their approval rules.
steps.bodyZh: PlingState 只暴露总数和当前筛选，不倾倒整个组件状态。写操作仍必须经过声明的动作和审批规则。

steps.title: Mount the shared assistant
steps.body: AgentDock is the same shared DOM dock used by the Vanilla adapter. This example enables the read-only Activity inspector and model settings.
steps.bodyZh: AgentDock 与 Vanilla 适配器使用同一个 DOM Dock。这个示例开启了只读的最近操作检查器和模型设置。

guide.note: This is a compatibility path, not a recommendation to start new React work on 16.3. New applications should use the Hooks entry on React 16.8+.
guide.noteZh: 这是兼容路径，不是建议新的 React 项目从 16.3 起步。新项目应在 React 16.8+ 上使用 Hooks 入口。
